App.name: Galmee Wholesale
App.tagline: Your notebook says people owe you money. This shows exactly who, how much, and since when.

features.owed: Who owes you, sorted by amount
features.statement: Every debt and repayment, with a running balance
features.offline: Works without internet and syncs later
